about.label: Costco
about.summary: American multinational corporation that operates a chain of membership-only big-box warehouse club retail stores.
about.summary_cs: Americký řetězec velkoobchodních prodejen, do kterých se nakupuje s členskou kartou.

about.label: Procter & Gamble
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce drogerie a hygienických potřeb se značkami jako Pampers, Gillette, Ariel a Head & Shoulders.

about.label: The Coca-Cola Company
about.summary: American multinational corporation founded in January 1892, headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. It manufactures, sells and markets soft drinks including Coca-Cola, other non-alcoholic beverage concentrates and syrups, and alcoholic beverages.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce nápojů, mimo jiné Coca-Coly, Sprite a Fanty.

about.label: Philip Morris International
about.summary: American publicly traded tobacco company, with products sold in over 180 countries.
about.summary_cs: Americká tabáková firma, která prodává cigarety (mimo jiné Marlboro) a bezdýmné výrobky ve více než 180 zemích.

about.label: Nestlé
about.summary: Swiss multinational food and drink processing conglomerate corporation headquartered in Vevey, Switzerland.
about.summary_cs: Švýcarský výrobce potravin a nápojů, největší na světě, se značkami jako Nescafé, KitKat a Maggi.

about.label: PepsiCo
about.summary: American multinational food and beverage corporation headquartered in Harrison, New York, in the hamlet of Purchase. PepsiCo's business encompasses all aspects of the food and beverage market.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce nápojů a snacků se značkami Pepsi, Lay's, Doritos a Gatorade.

about.label: Unilever
about.summary: British multinational consumer packaged goods company headquartered in London, England. It was founded in 1930 following the merger of Dutch margarine producer Margarine Unie with British soap maker Lever Brothers.
about.summary_cs: Britský výrobce potravin, kosmetiky a drogerie se značkami jako Dove, Rexona, Knorr a Hellmann's.

about.label: British American Tobacco
about.summary: British-American multinational company that manufactures and sells cigarettes, tobacco and other nicotine products including electronic cigarettes.
about.summary_cs: Britsko-americká firma, která vyrábí a prodává cigarety, tabák a další nikotinové výrobky včetně elektronických cigaret.

about.label: Altria
about.summary: American corporation and one of the world's largest producers and marketers of tobacco, cigarettes, and medical products in the treatment of illnesses caused by tobacco.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce cigaret (mimo jiné Marlboro v USA) a dalších tabákových a nikotinových výrobků.

about.label: L'Oréal
about.summary: French multinational personal care corporation registered in Paris and headquartered in Clichy, Hauts-de-Seine. As of the early 2020s, L'Oréal owned 36 brands and 497 patents.
about.summary_cs: Francouzská kosmetická firma, největší na světě, se značkami jako L'Oréal Paris, Garnier, Lancôme a Maybelline.

about.label: Mondelez International
about.summary: American multinational confectionery, food, holding, beverage, and snack food company based in Chicago. Mondelez has an annual revenue of about $38.5 billion and operates in approximately 160 countries.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce sladkostí a snacků, mimo jiné značek Milka, Oreo a Toblerone.

about.label: Target Corporation
about.summary: American retail corporation and discount department store chain headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota, United States.
about.summary_cs: Americký řetězec obchodních domů s potravinami, oblečením a zbožím pro domácnost.

about.label: Anheuser-Busch InBev
about.summary: Belgian multinational drink and brewing company based in Leuven, Belgium.
about.summary_cs: Belgická pivovarnická skupina, největší na světě, se značkami jako Budweiser, Stella Artois a Corona.

about.label: Colgate-Palmolive Company
about.summary: American multinational consumer products company headquartered on Park Avenue in Midtown Manhattan, New York City.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce zubních past, mýdel a krmiva pro zvířata, mimo jiné značek Colgate a Palmolive.

about.label: Monster Beverage
about.summary: American beverage company that manufactures energy drinks including Monster Energy, Relentless, Reign and Burn.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce energetických nápojů, hlavně značky Monster Energy.

about.label: Keurig Dr Pepper
about.summary: Publicly traded American beverage company headquartered in Burlington, Massachusetts, and Frisco, Texas. The company produces and distributes a range of hot and cold beverages, including brands such as Keurig, Dr Pepper, Snapple, Canada Dry, and others.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce nápojů včetně značek Keurig, Dr Pepper, Snapple a Canada Dry.

about.label: Archer Daniels Midland
about.summary: American multinational food processing and commodities trading corporation founded in 1902 and headquartered in Chicago, Illinois. The company also provides agricultural storage and transportation services.

about.label: Ahold Delhaize
about.summary: Dutch-Belgian multinational retail and wholesale holding company.
